A quiet evening of reading

8 min read · Updated last week

Late in the day, a bright white page feels like staring into a lamp. Most of the sites we read every night were designed for a sunny office, not a dim room, and they ignore the dark setting on your computer.

Dark mode should be a choice you make per site: the newspaper dark, the docs light, the mail app left exactly as its own designers intended.

Good tools stay out of the way, and they let you decide.
nightshade set fieldnotes.example --mode dynamic

One line, and this page goes dark tonight and every night after.
